sustains.t: Water from below and from the hills
sustains.d: Most of the city's water is pumped from the aquifer beneath it, refilled by rain on the forested mountains to the south and west. The rest is pumped uphill from outside the valley.
Chinampas, raised fields built from lake mud since before 1519, still farm the canals of Xochimilco.
59% of Mexico City's land is protected conservation land: forests, grasslands, wetlands and farms that recharge the aquifer.
